elements.name: young man seen from behind in centre
old boxy cream-coloured country bus seen from the side
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls
high bright sun with short shadows

wrong_setting: Instead of a bus, the man faces a round thatched hut with an open doorway. There is no town, no tin-roofed houses and no eucalyptus trees. The scene reads as an isolated rural hut on a pale empty background.
notes: Regenerate with the cream country bus side-on (door open, bundles on the roof rack) in place of the thatched hut, add the town's tin-roofed mud houses, eucalyptus trees and short midday shadows, and paint the scene fully to all four edges with no pale unpainted margins.
